before_experiment.hypothesis: Sensor-attribute preservation is behavior-neutral across complete real recordings, not only no-obstacle prefixes.

criterion.discrete: All non-timing statuses, objects, IDs, integer support counts, confirmation flags, evidence timestamps and list order must agree; any mismatch is investigated.
criterion.numeric: Report every unequal numeric leaf; absolute/relative tolerance 1e-9 is declared before replay for continuous floating estimates only. IDs, counters, flags and source timestamps must be exact.
criterion.coverage: Every emitted unique measurement until EOF from all nine configured bags. Require manifests and ingestion counts; no intersection-of-frames-only acceptance. Report actual state coverage and unsupported cases.
criterion.diagnostics: All legacy arrays byte-identical; exact original-slot/value/valid-mask alignment for saved diagnostic representative stages.
criterion.resources: Measure processing/decode/wall and cumulative process peak RSS for sequential same-machine runs; report regressions honestly without asserting field latency or recall.

after_experiment.hypothesis: A bounded measured-rail point-to-line correction of lateral/vertical translation and rotation can reduce return discrepancy without changing forward ICP displacement, worsening registration, inventing stationary travel, or losing the existing labelled-recording alarm gate.
after_experiment.criterion: All six complete recordings. Stationary total travel no worse than matched baseline; each of three named return discrepancies strictly lower (endpoint coincidence is NOT ground truth); accepted registration residual/overlap not worse; weak-axis flag not falsely cleared; no loss of baseline hazardous frames on doubleT_obstacle. Continuous comparison numerical tolerance 1e-9, no integer-count tolerance. Any failed criterion rejects promotion.
after_experiment.method_scope: Original constrained rail-point registration experiment, NOT a reproduction of multi-sensor RailLoMer. Nominal gauge is not imposed by correction; upstream rail selection still has its original nominal-gauge candidate prior. Nonrail validation is disjoint from rail fitting but shares the sensor and ICP initialization. Raw KISS map remains untouched; corrected poses only feed detector association.
after_experiment.promotion: disabled unless every acceptance criterion is met; no post-panel threshold tuning

smoke_summary.accuracy_validity: No ground truth implied by bag name or alarm count
smoke_summary.latency_scope: Offline iteration: bag read/deserialization/decode, inference, optional diagnostic/RViz-bag writes, result JSON serialization and buffered write. Excludes timing-log write, fsync, live DDS queues/transport and viewer rendering; not sensor-to-display age. With prefetch_depth > 0 the read/deserialization/decode of the next scan runs on one producer thread while inference runs on this one, so read_and_process_ms is the cost of one loop iteration, not the age of a decision: a scan still waits for the scan ahead of it to finish. Wall_s / frames is the throughput that overlap buys.
